flow: application -> planner selected target -> conversational wording -> patient
patient and full message history -> extractor -> validate and append snapshots
application reconciles coverage and participation -> planner -> next target
provisional synthesis at handoff or professional review checkpoint

authority.clinical: Original module knowledge, source locators and precedence/update notes
authority.evidence_output: Original per-module evidence_output.schema.json; do not replace with an older workspace schema
authority.routing: Existing question_graph.json plus route_completion.json supplement overlay
authority.measurement: Measurement/knowledge.json and reviewed instrument profile; scoring by code only

message_contract.speaker: patient or assistant
message_contract.text: Verbatim message/transcript; media uncertainty retained outside clinical findings

application_state.adult_age: Confirmed age >=18; no upper limit; developmental and older-adult communication needs retained
application_state.period_bindings: Explicit contact/current/longterm/lifetime/cycle -> actual period IDs; create distinct bindings for distinct episodes
application_state.message_history: Ordered immutable original messages, including earlier questions needed to interpret yes/no
application_state.snapshots: Validated module snapshots appended across turns; never erase older reports
application_state.coverage: Target + actual period + revision + support + finding status; software coverage is not diagnosis
application_state.blocked_targets: Scoped decline/defer decisions independent of earlier findings
application_state.branch_facts: open/not_indicated/unknown with reason and evidence; missing is unknown
application_state.supplement_requests: Explicit unresolved requirements for a route_completion conditional target
application_state.corrections: Explicit source-linked correction relations; recency alone never means the older fact is false
application_state.care_context: Goals/preferences/access needs stored separately; do not discard clinically relevant function, stressors or barriers
application_state.therapy_specific_parameters: Separate therapy-state namespace; not counted as depressive diagnostic criteria

input: target definition and relevant attribute definition
conversational.clinical_role: Wording only; no independent target or diagnosis selection

extractor.output: Array of per-module snapshots; each independently matches its module evidence_output.schema.json. Empty records allowed when no supported clinical finding.
extractor.flexibility: Attributes differ by concept; use only defined attributes and their allowed values. Omit unmentioned optional attributes; never populate them with guessed frequency or duration.
extractor.evidence_ids: Model does not invent evidence IDs. Message IDs are application supplied; snapshot positions/revisions may be application assigned.

planner.rule: One next action and one selected target when asking. Candidate selection is justified by missing information, not by filling every field.

input: rules/reference tables and current source precedence
scores with administration metadata if valid
diagnosis_synthesis.rule: Provisional explanations and criterion-by-criterion evidence review; no confirmed diagnosis, prescribing or automatic care activation.

tools.get_context: Application calls knowledge_access.get_context(role, target_ids, module_names) and supplies returned JSON. Model cannot read disk just because a prompt says it can.
tools.validate_snapshot: Application calls knowledge_access.validate_snapshot(module, snapshot, messages); checks schema and provenance mechanics, not clinical truth.
tools.history: Application supplies full ordered history or a traceable complete evidence ledger plus retrievable original messages; never silently truncate necessary antecedents.
tools.routing: Application may call next_with_supplements with annotated state. Semantic extraction and appropriateness still require evaluation.
tools.score: Optional reviewed Measurement/score_answers.py only; no narrative-to-score guessing.
